card.name: Inside capitalized acronyms
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the second or later part of an all-caps acronym or abbreviation, such as NHL, CFR, RC, VD, HS or MCC, usually just before the acronym ends or is followed by a hyphen, digit or following word.

modes.description: The CFR part of a US federal regulation citation after a number.
